# BudgetThing

BudgetThing is a fast expense tracker with optional cloud sync.

## Agent Import API

- Docs: https://budgetthing.vanshraja.me/agents/budgetthing/
- Skill: https://budgetthing.vanshraja.me/agents/budgetthing/SKILL.md
- OpenAPI: https://budgetthing.vanshraja.me/agents/budgetthing/openapi.json

The Import API accepts structured expense and income candidates only. It does not accept raw emails, messages, OCR dumps, files, card numbers, or bank statements.
